articles.title: Retail Location Intelligence Grows in Sophistication and Usage
articles.narrative: This article highlights the increasing sophistication and essential role of location intelligence technology in retail real estate. Advanced platforms, leveraging AI and machine learning, can now predict retail success metrics like revenue and cash-on-cash returns for specific sites, considering hundreds of demographic, psychographic, and competitive factors. This technology allows retailers and brokers to make highly informed decisions, adapting to rapidly changing market conditions and consumer behaviors. Industry professionals emphasize that this data-driven approach has transformed brokerage into a consulting business, providing clients with the confidence needed for strategic site selection and expansion.

articles.title: GreenBarn’s David Welsh and David Schonbraun Aren’t Afraid of a Little Complexity
articles.narrative: GreenBarn Investment Group, co-founded by industry veterans David Welsh and David Schonbraun, has rapidly grown to manage approximately $3.5 billion in investments since its rebranding in 2023. The firm specializes in complex, opportunistic credit investments across various sectors and capital structures, leveraging the partners' extensive experience in capital markets, lending, and real estate operations. GreenBarn's strategy involves actively pursuing challenging deals, including debt restructurings, recapitalizations, and mezzanine loans, often partnering with former competitors and relying on direct relationships for deal flow.

articles.title: Butlr’s New Thermal Sensor Products Aim at Occupancy and Restrooms
articles.narrative: Butlr, a physical artificial intelligence technology company, has launched two new products, Ask Butlr and its Smart Cleaning module, aimed at optimizing building operations. Ask Butlr is an AI-powered analyst tool that provides building operators with data-backed insights on occupancy, dwell time, foot traffic, and energy consumption, facilitating strategic space planning and capital real estate investments. The Smart Cleaning module, integrated into Butlr's spatial intelligence platform, utilizes anonymized usage data to reduce restroom cleaning costs by directing staff to areas that require attention, moving away from fixed maintenance schedules. These solutions leverage thermal body heat sensing technology and machine learning to infer human behavior without compromising privacy, addressing a growing need for accurate first-party data in buildings.

articles.title: Forbearances, Modifications Carry Weight in Latest Data
articles.narrative: CRED iQ's latest analysis of commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) and commercial real estate collateralized loan obligation (CRE CLO) loan modifications from May through July 2026 reveals a significant shift in the landscape of distressed commercial real estate. The report tracked 82 modified loans totaling $2.36 billion, noting that while maturity extensions remain a key tool, forbearances and combination modifications are now playing a more prominent role, indicating lenders are employing a broader range of strategies beyond simple 'extend and pretend' tactics. Notably, multifamily loans have emerged as the leading property type for modifications, surpassing hotels and office properties, suggesting that rate resets on floating-rate loans and slower rent growth are impacting borrowers in this sector. The data also indicates that distress is now concentrated in midsize loans, particularly those in the $20 million to $50 million range, rather than a few mega-loans, reflecting a broadening of modification activity across the market.

articles.title: Trepp’s Stephen Buschbom and Andy Boettcher On a Very Busy 2026 for CMBS
articles.narrative: The commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) market is poised to surpass its initial issuance projections for 2026, driven primarily by single-asset, single-borrower (SASB) transactions. Trepp analysts Stephen Buschbom and Andy Boettcher note that while overall CMBS volume is strong, the market is experiencing a significant shift in composition, with SASB deals accounting for a dominant share compared to pre-COVID levels. This trend is attributed to buyer preferences for more targeted portfolio management and banks' increased comfort in managing specific credit risks. Despite rising distress, particularly in the office sector, the market is showing signs of stabilization, with banks having largely reserved for their commercial real estate exposure and demonstrating healthy lending growth, which in turn supports liquidity for CMBS maturities and rollovers.

articles.title: Connell Co. Begins Leasing 179-Unit Apartment Building in Berkeley Heights, New Jersey
articles.narrative: The Connell Co. has commenced leasing at RT500, a new 179-unit apartment building in Berkeley Heights, New Jersey. This 11-story residential property is part of The Park, a larger 185-acre mixed-use development. The building offers a variety of floor plans and a comprehensive suite of amenities, with construction having topped out last summer.

data_points.notable_features: Located within The Park, a 185-acre mixed-use development; amenities include an outdoor pool, entertainment lounge, game room, fitness center, and coworking space.
data_points.project_notes: One of two buildings at The Park under Connell’s Round Table (RT) Residences brand. Rents start at approximately $2,600 per month for a studio apartment.

articles.title: Canyon Partners Provides $74.4M Construction Loan for Inland Empire BTR Project
articles.narrative: Canyon Partners and J.P. Morgan have provided a $74.7 million construction loan to BCT Development, a joint venture between Bain Capital Real Estate and Cherry Tree Development. The financing will support the development of a 180-unit built-to-rent townhome community in Riverside's Mission Grove neighborhood. This represents Canyon Partners' second construction loan to BCT Development this year for a rental townhome project in Riverside.

data_points.notable_features: Community amenities will include a pool, fitness center, and clubhouse.

articles.title: Trammell Crow Co. Completes 181,000 SF Mixed-Use Project in Phoenix
articles.narrative: Trammell Crow Co. has completed an 8-acre, 181,000-square-foot mixed-use development in Phoenix. The project includes a 145,000-square-foot Class A office building, a 25,000-square-foot flagship grocery store, and 11,000 square feet of additional retail space. The grocery store opened in July 2026, and the office building is ready for occupancy.

data_points.notable_features: The headquarters building features a community garden, rooftop deck, fitness center, and culinary kitchens.
data_points.project_notes: The office building serves as a corporate headquarters for a major grocery chain.

articles.title: Freestone Capital Acquires 106-Unit Multifamily Property in Seattle for $32.2M
articles.narrative: Freestone Capital has acquired Aperture on Fifth, a 106-unit multifamily property in Seattle's Denny Triangle neighborhood, from PrivatePortfolio Group for $32.2 million. The transaction was brokered by Institutional Property Advisors, representing both the seller and the buyer, both of whom are based in Seattle.

data_points.notable_features: Features a central atrium courtyard, rooftop deck with a bocce ball court, fitness center, bike storage, package lockers, pet wash area, and underground parking garage. Some units offer views of the Space Needle and downtown Seattle skyline.

articles.title: Northmarq Arranges $23.5M Sale of Two-Property Multifamily Portfolio in Northern California
articles.narrative: Northmarq has facilitated the $23.5 million sale of a two-property multifamily portfolio in Ukiah, California. Ridge Capital Investments sold the 121-unit portfolio to an undisclosed buyer. The properties, Sierra Sunset Village and Alderwood Apartments, offer a mix of two- and three-bedroom residences with various amenities.

data_points.property_name: Sierra Sunset Village and Alderwood Apartments
data_points.address: 505-531 Capps Lane and 1416 and 1450 S. State St, Ukiah, CA
data_points.notable_features: Sierra Sunset Village features a swimming pool, fitness center, and outdoor picnic area. Alderwood Apartments offers a resort-style swimming pool, covered garage parking, and outdoor grilling areas.

articles.title: Phoenix Investors acquires 1.8 million square feet of industrial property in Saginaw area
articles.narrative: Phoenix Investors has acquired a 1.8 million-square-foot industrial portfolio comprising three buildings in Buena Vista Charter Township, part of the Saginaw, Michigan area. The transaction involved a sale-leaseback arrangement, with Nexteer Automotive continuing to occupy 1.27 million square feet across two buildings. Phoenix Investors plans to make significant capital investments to reposition the remaining 552,000 square feet in Plant 5 for new industrial users, leveraging the property's established manufacturing infrastructure and strategic location to attract further investment to the region.

data_points.property_name: Plants 5, 6/1, and 7 (former General Motors Saginaw Steering Gear complex)
data_points.notable_features: Located near I-75 and M-46 (Holland Road) within an established manufacturing corridor with strong ties to the automotive and advanced manufacturing industries.
data_points.project_notes: Nexteer Automotive will lease back approximately 1.27 million square feet across two buildings (Plants 6/1 and 7). Approximately 552,000 square feet in Plant 5 is currently available for lease. Nexteer retained ownership of adjacent plants (Plant 3 and Plant 4) and land, including a solar field and test track.

articles.title: Habitat reaches key milestones at two Chicago mixed-income developments
articles.narrative: Habitat has reached significant milestones at two mixed-income developments in Chicago, underscoring the strong demand for attainable housing integrated with community services and retail. The first residential phase of the LeClaire Courts redevelopment in Garfield Ridge has achieved financial closing, initiating construction for 183 mixed-income apartments, 90% of which will be affordable. Concurrently, The Junction at OC Living, the second residential phase of the Ogden Commons development in North Lawndale, has reached full lease-up, demonstrating sustained demand for quality affordable housing in the area. These projects reflect Habitat's commitment to creating vibrant, community-centered developments that provide essential amenities like healthcare, childcare, and retail alongside housing.

data_points.notable_features: The first phase includes two six-story mixed-use buildings with studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom floor plans, and will feature a day care center operated by Chicago Commons.
data_points.project_notes: The 32-acre site was formerly the LeClaire Courts public housing complex, demolished in 2011. Funding sources include a $27 million capital loan from the Chicago Housing Authority, $9.5 million in city multifamily program funds, $5.5 million in tax-increment financing, $33.7 million in Low-Income Housing Tax Credit equity, $1.25 million in Illinois Affordable Housing Tax Credit equity, and a $1.2 million deferred developer fee.

articles.title: Trademark Property Company purchases 116,000-square-foot shopping center in Austin
articles.narrative: Trademark Property Company, in partnership with Cohen & Steers, has acquired Oak Hill Plaza, a 116,000-square-foot neighborhood shopping center in Austin, TX. Trademark will also manage and lease the property, with plans to upgrade the center and enhance its tenant mix. The acquisition is strategically timed with the near completion of the $674 million Oak Hill Parkway Project, which is expected to significantly improve access and mobility to the property.

data_points.notable_features: Located at the northwest corner of US 290 and SH 71, benefiting from the recently completed Oak Hill Parkway Project.
data_points.project_notes: The acquisition follows the substantial completion of TXDOT’s $674 million Oak Hill Parkway Project, which improves regional mobility and access to the property.

articles.title: Kansas City Chiefs, Hunt Midwest launch two-point development to steer mixed-use districts in Kansas City, Kansas
articles.narrative: The Kansas City Chiefs and Hunt Midwest have formed Two-Point Development, a joint venture to master develop two mixed-use districts in Kansas City, Kansas, and Olathe, Kansas. These developments will surround the Chiefs' new stadium and new headquarters/training facility, respectively. The partnership aims to create premier, year-round sports and entertainment destinations that will stimulate economic activity, attract investment, and build community hubs, blending entertainment, hospitality, retail, residential, and public gathering spaces.

data_points.notable_features: Two distinct mixed-use districts will be developed around a new NFL stadium and a new NFL headquarters/training facility.
data_points.project_notes: The development is supported by the State of Kansas, Kansas Department of Commerce, Unified Government of Wyandotte County and Kansas City, Kansas, City of Olathe, and Johnson County.

articles.title: Terra Lands $245M Financing for Newly Completed Upland Park Development
articles.narrative: Terra has secured $245 million in permanent financing for the first phase of Upland Park, a newly completed 578-unit multifamily community in West Miami-Dade County. The property, which is part of a larger $1 billion mixed-use development, is already over 60% leased within 90 days of opening. Construction on the second residential phase, comprising 484 additional apartments, is slated to commence later this year.

data_points.notable_features: Transit-oriented development with a mix of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, and extensive community amenities including pools, pickleball courts, and a dog park.
data_points.project_notes: This financing is for the first phase of a larger $1 billion, 47-acre mixed-use development. The second residential phase, adding 484 multifamily apartments, is expected to begin construction later this year.

articles.title: Gatsby Florida Inks $118.6M Construction Loan for Palm Beach Gardens Offices, Retail
articles.narrative: Gatsby Florida has secured an $118.6 million construction loan for The Palm, a new mixed-use development in Palm Beach Gardens, FL. The project will feature 200,000 square feet of Class A office space and 30,000 square feet of ground-floor retail and restaurant space. Construction is slated to begin shortly, with completion anticipated in 2028.

data_points.address: 11200 RCA Center Drive, Palm Beach Gardens, FL
data_points.notable_features: Eight-story Class A office and retail development with an 838-space structured parking garage, EV charging stations, a rooftop terrace, conference facilities, and a fitness center.

articles.title: IRG Acquires 423K-SF Distribution Facility in St. Paul
articles.narrative: Industrial Realty Group (IRG) has acquired a 422,727-square-foot industrial distribution facility in South St. Paul, Minnesota, for $21 million. The property, formerly the headquarters of an online and catalog retailer, is strategically located with excellent access to the broader Minneapolis-St. Paul interstate network. JLL has been retained to oversee leasing for the facility, which is well-suited for cross-dock distribution operations.

data_points.address: 411 Farwell Avenue, South St. Paul, MN
data_points.notable_features: Configured for cross-dock distribution operations with 36 dock-high doors, two drive-in doors, and 22-foot clear height. Located approximately two minutes from Interstate 494.
data_points.project_notes: Property was formerly the headquarters of an online and catalog retailer.

articles.title: Evergreen Real Estate Group Breaks Ground on Three Housing Communities in Ohio
articles.narrative: Evergreen Real Estate Group has commenced construction on three affordable assisted living communities in Ohio, near Dayton and Columbus. Each Green Oaks development will feature 120 units for seniors, offering a mix of studio and one-bedroom apartments. The projects are designed to provide residential care facilities for a range of income levels.

data_points.project_notes: Each community will be licensed as a residential care facility.

articles.title: Greenstone Partners Brokers Two Chicago Multifamily Transactions
articles.narrative: Greenstone Partners recently brokered two multifamily transactions in Chicago, totaling $3.27 million. The deals included the sale of an eight-unit property in Wicker Park for $2.245 million and a three-unit building with a coach house and an adjacent development lot in Bridgeport for $1.025 million. The Bridgeport property offers both existing rental income and future value-creation opportunities through potential rent growth, additional parking income, and development optionality.

data_points.notable_features: Recently renovated property with one- and two-bedroom units.

articles.title: Cortland Sells West Palm Apartments For $208M: The South Florida Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Cortland Partners has sold a multifamily complex in West Palm Beach to Fairfield Residential for $208 million. This transaction represents one of the top multifamily sales in South Florida, highlighting continued strong investor interest in the region's residential assets.

articles.title: Chicago's Slow Apartment Pipeline Fueling Deals And Adaptive Reuse
articles.narrative: Chicago's apartment market is experiencing a significant supply shortage, leading to increased activity in creative deal structures and the adaptive reuse of office buildings for residential purposes. This trend is driven by a slow pipeline of new apartment construction, which is failing to keep pace with demand.

articles.title: Lab Landlords In 'Hand-To-Hand Combat' To Last To Recovery
articles.narrative: The national lab real estate market is experiencing significant challenges, with rental rates declining substantially since 2023. Landlords are currently engaged in intense competition to maintain their positions and survive until a market recovery.

articles.title: 'This Is A Big Change For Me': Leslie Cohen Launching New Company After Leaving Davis Cos.
articles.narrative: Leslie Cohen, a seasoned Boston real estate executive, is establishing Ops Alchemy, a new venture aimed at assisting smaller real estate firms in optimizing their operational efficiencies. This new company marks a significant career transition for Cohen, leveraging her extensive experience to provide specialized operational support to the industry.

articles.title: Real Estate Firm Debuts With $126M Purchase Of Historic D.C. Building
articles.narrative: A newly formed real estate firm, Montclif, in partnership with FCP, has acquired the historic Hamilton Square building in Washington D.C. for $126 million. This acquisition marks the debut transaction for Montclif, a company founded this year by experienced D.C. real estate professionals.
